title: Russian Movies Weekend #18
languages: Russian Audio, English subtitles All children dream of having a twin who could sit exams for them. That is what happens to the boy Serezha Syroezhkin, only his double is a highly intelligent robot called Electronic. But finding himself in the world of people, Electronic is upset that he himself is not human.One of the most popular children’s films, it also produced some wonderful songs—one of them, “Winged Swings,” became iconic.♥ Previously on “Russian Movies Weekend”
